EV-000959

Kissing number in dimension 20 · Sphere packing and kissing · status current

Definition

tau_20 = the maximum number of non-overlapping unit spheres in R^20 that touch a central unit sphere.

\tau_{20}=\max\{|X|:\ X\subset S^{19},\ \langle x,y\rangle\le\tfrac12\ (x\ne y)\}

Domain: point sets on the unit sphere S^19. Normalisation: count. Direction: unstated.

Current value

19448 <= tau_20 <= 36195 (bound)

Source: H. Cohn, Kissing numbers (table of upper and lower bounds), page revision 2026-10-11 https://cohn.mit.edu/kissing-numbers 2026-10-11
